item.title: Guam · Buenas yan Håfa Adai! Please join me in presenting Resolution No. 238-38 (COR ) – “Relative to recognizing Lucia Eustaquio Garcia McDonald on the celebration of one hundred (100) years of longevity; and commending her as a Centenarian.” Please be advised that the presentation will take place on Sunday, November 29, 2026, at 11:00 a.m. at Government House. We look forward to your presence and participation. Si Yu’os Ma’åse’! 11/24/26 4:00 PM (FN) (* Presentation for Resolution No. 238-38 (COR) - Senator Chris Duenas) — Nov 29, 2026, 11:00 AM · R23838
